meta.title: Revision history on the buyer side
gaps: Step through Vendor A’s revision-history arrows and verify each revision’s displayed price and timestamp.
Verify that Reset returns the revision-history view to the current bid.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Step through Vendor A’s revision-history arrows and verify each revision’s displayed price and timestamp.; Verify that Reset returns the revision-history view to the current bid.

steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation flow.
Provide the required event title.
Create an RFQ pricing stage for the vendor bid revisions.
Configure the RFQ stage.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add one line item for the bid.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet.
Commit a live bidding schedule.
Invite the QA vendor used as Vendor A.
Publish the event so Vendor A can submit and revise a bid.
Verify the event reached a published project page.
Submit Vendor A’s initial bid of 100.
Verify the initial bid was accepted.
Revise Vendor A’s bid to 95 using the same vendor session.
Verify the first revision was accepted.
Revise Vendor A’s bid again to 90.
Verify the second revision was accepted.
Open the buyer’s Responses view where revision history is expected to be inspected.
Verify the buyer sees Vendor A’s direct response before attempting the unsupported revision-history inspection.
Check for the current-bid revision label if the revision trail is rendered automatically.
Check for the second revision label if the trail is rendered automatically.
Check for the first revision label if the trail is rendered automatically.
